import numpy as np

def _args(cross_section_structure, perpendicular_correlation_lengths, stratified_background):
    z = np.linspace(0.0, 120.0, 41)
    bg = stratified_background(z.copy(), 1.5, 42.0, 12.5, 0.8, 3.6, 400.0, 0.62, 0.83, 45.0, 0.1)
    sp = cross_section_structure(bg[1].copy(), bg[5].copy(), 0.16)
    ll = perpendicular_correlation_lengths(bg[4].copy(), bg[5].copy(), 0.16, bg[2].copy(), bg[3].copy())
    wk = 0.9 * np.exp(-z / 90.0)
    wo = 0.5 * np.exp(-z / 150.0)
    wi = 0.025 * np.exp((z - 120.0) / 90.0)
    return (wk, wo, wi, bg[1].copy(), sp[0].copy(), ll[0].copy(), ll[1].copy())
assert np.allclose(deposition_rates(*_args(cross_section_structure, perpendicular_correlation_lengths, stratified_background)), target)
